title: Color Halftone
description: Separates an image into crisp cyan, magenta and yellow print dots while preserving its large forms.

parameters.label: Effect
parameters.description: How strongly the color print replaces the image.

parameters.label: Dot Density
parameters.description: Number of separated color-screen cells across the short side.

parameters.label: Dot Size
parameters.description: Radius of the dots without moving the screen grid.

parameters.label: Contrast
parameters.description: How rapidly dot size responds to the source tone.

parameters.label: Screen Angle
parameters.description: Rotates all three print screens together.

parameters.label: Ink
parameters.description: Density of the subtractive print inks.
